reviews.title: Where do we even start this?
reviews.text:
The stream quality for games on this app are outdated running at 720p (barely) and yet somehow felt justified to increase the price. 

Increase for what? Normally if you’re going to increase your prices by as much as you do, that means you are adding or providing some form of increased value to your consumer, yet you offer the same garbage.

Speaking of “add value” let’s talk about Sportsnet+

This might be the most tone deaf decision this company has made since renewing Ron MacLean’s contract this summer. 

So let me get this straight, you are not adding any new content or interactivity, but now instead add a new paywall for people already playing to watch their favourite sports teams play on Monday? My god how absolutely tone deaf and out of touch this company is. 

Rogers is a shining example why governments need to regulate these companies so they can’t have a monopoly and pull stunts like this to sodomize their customers. 

I’m usually someone that encourages supporting companies and subscribing. However, if I had to choose between this garbage and pirating, I would rather risk corrupting my computer through piracy than support this company any longer.

reviews.title: NHL Package
reviews.text:
Rogers has driven me away from watching hockey. Poor product, poor customer service, high app cost expectation vs product provided. 
  I had numerous issues when watching hockey. My last straw was twice the network crashing during the Bluejays World Series run. Both times, notices came up on screen that the issue was my connection. Meanwhile all across the country the issue was happening at the same time. I was also able to stream other services while Rogers was telling me I had issues.
   Last year I watched one hockey game and that was only because I was at a friend’s. This year, haven’t watched anything and there is no desire to. Haven’t purchased any NHL merchandise in that time and most likely won’t for the foreseeable future. 
  I was a Blackhawk fan for 40 years. Being on the west coast, only way to watch regularly was using the NHL package.
  I’ve talked people out of purchasing the app after telling them my experience and will continue at any opportunity. 
   I emailed the NHL about my experience and haven’t heard anything back. Their silence tells me they are alright with the issues. 
  Rogers app, user beware….

reviews.title: FIRE EVERYONE involved in overseeing the development and maintenance of this expensive garbage
reviews.text:
Premium prices. Embarrassing execution.

Everyone responsible for the quality of this app, from management to development and quality assurance, should be embarrassed. For a company with Rogers’ resources, and at these subscription prices, this is an unacceptable experience.

Between my own experience, other customers’ reports and Sportsnet’s documented limitations, there is plenty to criticize:

1. EXPENSIVE: These subscription prices create an expectation of quality that the experience simply doesn’t meet.
2. DISAPPOINTING PICTURE QUALITY: Watching fast moving sports makes a poor picture especially frustrating.
3. NO 4K STREAMING: It’s 2026, and the app still doesn’t offer 4K. At these prices, that deserves criticism.
4. FREEZING AND BUFFERING: The action carries on while you’re staring at a frozen picture.
5. DROPPED STREAMS: Having playback cut out and needing to restart it defeats the purpose of paying for reliable live coverage.
6. BROKEN SIGN IN: Login problems and blank screens can prevent you from even reaching the game. This is basic functionality.
7. PAID SUBSCRIPTIONS NOT BEING RECOGNIZED: Sportsnet has a support page specifically for valid Apple subscriptions with channels that won’t unlock. Paying customers should not have to troubleshoot access to their purchases.
8. CASTING ERRORS: Getting the game from your device onto your television introduces another potential technical headache.
9. INCONSISTENT DEVICE PERFORMANCE: Customers report switching between televi

It’s 2026 and no Roku or smart tv app. Rogers handcuffs your mobile device to stream their products.
A backwards thinking company. 
They won’t get my internet or mobile contracts.

reviews.title: Impossible to Login Now?
reviews.text: Do you know that users cannot login to the App with their subscriptions? I’ve been trying for weeks but when you try to login it continues to load a blank screen instead of the usual username and password lines. Very frustrating for a paid service.

reviews.title: Wanted to like this
reviews.text: Subscriptions are an absolute mess. Subscription from AppleTV doesn’t work on other devices despite using the same email. Missed a key playoff game.

reviews.title: Chrome cast is unusable
reviews.text: This app is easily the worst on the market. When I try to cast their product to the TV it takes 7 attempts. Sometimes it plays without audio, other times it joins the stream 45min earlier in the game with no way of getting live. Sometimes it randomly decides to add subtitles. BIGGEST SCAM IN WATCHING SPORTS! As paying customers we deserve better!

reviews.title: Worst streaming service
reviews.text: This is the worst streaming service I have ever used. I frequently have no sound so I have to refresh an until it works. Casting to a tv always takes several tries and restarting the app. Then when I finally do get it working it crashes all the time.

reviews.title: Sportsnet+
reviews.text: Overpriced. I don’t need to say more

reviews.title: Needs a lot of bug fixes
reviews.text: My problems with Sportsnet are laughable.  First, pressing restart launches the game live, which is incredibly frustrating and ruins the whole experience.  Second, the phone app sometimes inexplicably stops playing. Third, when I try to connect to Chromecast, it just won’t work, while every other app connects perfectly. Finally, as soon as I open the Sportsnet app, it starts playing the Blue Jays game in the background, even though I’m not watching them. This ruins the game for me or, if I press play it takes me to the end of the game so I completely lose out on enjoying the game so it’s frustrating. Honestly, I wish there were other options, but unfortunately, there aren’t.

reviews.title: Just awful
reviews.text: Every year I sign up to watch the Jays hoping the app has been improved, and every year I’m proven remarkably wrong. Last year the app would freeze, and restart airplay without reason…well this year it does the same thing, except now it’ll start the broadcast over again and the “go live” button doesn’t do anything.

reviews.title: The worst
reviews.text: This app makes me want to cancel my subscription

reviews.title: Horrible app
reviews.text: Quality sucks, it’s slow, it lags, just all around terrible app. But they got you because where else can you stream nhl and mlb without 🏴‍☠️

reviews.title: This app sucks
reviews.text: Not loading when you try to watch playoff hockey. Everytime I open this app I wonder if Im gonna be able to watch my games.

reviews.title: Too expensive for quality
reviews.text: I pay for the premium exclusive package, so over $300 a year. I have to click in and out of a game and shutdown the app multiple times to get audio. This is what I expect from bootleg streams, not a $300 app. Bit of a joke if you ask me

reviews.title: Do you hear what I hear??🎄
reviews.text: I hear nothing. While trying to watch the playoffs I need to refresh the app more than 10 times just to have sound… absolutely ridiculous and so frustrating. Go habs

reviews.title: Sportsnet review
reviews.text: Sportsnets options are amazing. You can watch any NHL game (mind you have to pay an additional premium for this), half the raptors game and all the blue jays games. That is all this app offers, everything else is just terrible. The overall quality is the worst of any steaming app ever made. The sound will not work and you will spend 5-10 minutes trying to finally get it to work. The App often freezes and will not load the game you want to watch. You can find better picture quality on illegal streams. There have been Reddit reviews for years complaining about the poor quality and it’s mind boggling that you pay hundreds of dollars a year and they don’t even bother to try and fix it. This review applies to both mobile devices and TVs. Unfortunately it’s the only way to watch any NHL game but before subscribing prepare to become extremely frustrated with how horrible this app is!

reviews.title: Poorly made
reviews.text: Delayed stream, sound doesn’t work a lot of the time, subpar video quality, crazy price, can’t share more than 2 screens, etc. The price increase to this app is diabolical. Textbook corporate greed. Better off just pirating.

reviews.title: Sportsnet +
reviews.text: App is always kicking me out of games, not letting me sign in or not even loading. Love paying 250 plus a year for this. Wish there was another way to watch sports.

reviews.title: Buggy
reviews.text: Hard to use this to stream sports when for some reason there is no volume a lot of the time (have to restart the app multiple times, sometimes it works, most of the time it still doesn’t work), and when you have the video paused, the ability to fast forward randomly goes away so you’re stuck where you are. Awful.

reviews.title: Audio
reviews.text: Audio bugs resulting in no audio. Restarting app doesn’t resolve it.

reviews.title: No audio and black screen of death
reviews.text: No audio and when changing to another channel or show get black screen of death

reviews.title: Lousy
reviews.text: Lousy app…doesn’t work half the time.  Crashes, loading issues and a lot of no volume.

reviews.title: Volume issues
reviews.text: Recently when I want to watch a broadcast, the video works perfectly but there is no audio. I have reset this thing so many times but it still doesn’t work. Quite frustrating with how much it costs for a subscription!

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text:
This is the worst app ever created. It’s glitchy and crashes out constantly. It freezes, it loses sound, it closes, it loses picture quality, etc. etc. 
This app is overpriced and under performs every. Single. Time. I. Use. It.

reviews.title: Viewing difficulties
reviews.text: Always blurry or/and always buffering, games not archived, could not watch Game 4 of the World Series featuring the team that you own.

reviews.title: Bugs galore
reviews.text: So I paid $282 CAD after tax for a subscription on a app that is constantly cutting in and out and pausing while I’m streaming. Stream quality is awful, 30fps and the app on my iPhone 16 will randomly stop responding. My app is fully updated and I have 1Gbps internet speed so I shouldn’t have any issues streaming. Can’t forget that the video doesn’t work on my computer app and sometimes the app just won’t load. All of those bugs for the low low price of $282.

reviews.title: Glitchy, Buffering, poor quality
reviews.text: The app has so many bugs.It’s consistently crashing or buffering. Bounces between HD and low quality. Delayed broadcast too I have to tell my dad not to text spoilers because the app doesn’t keep up with the live feed on the Sportsnet channels. It’s bad on my phone and even worse on my PlayStation
